1. Toque no tubo de origem e depois no d:
1. Tap the source tube, then the target. Only the top block of a single color is transferred.

2. Any unlocked tube with space can receive sand, even on another color. If only part fits, the rest stays in the source. A valid pour counts as one move.

3. To change source without pouring, hold the new tube briefly. Tap the selected tube again to cancel.

4. Every tube containing sand must be full and have a single color. Spare tubes may finish empty. Undo counts as a move; restart resets the attempt. Undo is at the top; Restart is in the level menu.

5. Completing a level earns one star. Earn two with at most 50% more moves than the minimum, or three with at most 20% more. Replay to improve your stars and best score.

2. When a pour is not allowed, tap another tube containing sand to change source. Tap the selected tube again to cancel.

3. Fill each tube with a single color. Spare tubes may remain empty. Undo uses one move; restart resets the attempt.

4. Some levels have a move limit; others have a timer. Time starts on the first move and pauses in menus, during animations and while the app is in the background. Winning on the last allowed move counts.

5. Earn three stars with at most 20% more moves than the minimum, or two with at most 50% more. Replay to improve your best score.
